# uniconn — LLM & AI Agent API Reference (v0.6.0)

> Universal async-first Python library (Python 3.11+) and CLI for executing commands and managing files across SSH, Telnet, Serial/UART, IPMI BMC, and Local transports.

## Quick Facts & Commands
- Package manager: `uv`
- Install all dependencies: `uv sync`
- Run unit tests: `uv run pytest -m "not integration"`
- Lint & typecheck: `uv run ruff check src/` and `uv run pyright`
- Preview dashboard server: `python3 main.py --serve` (listens on `0.0.0.0:3000`)

## Public Exports (`from uniconn import ...`)
- **Core**: `Connection`, `SyncConnection`, `ConnectionConfig`, `Result`, `quote`
- **Pools**: `ConnectionPool`, `SSHSessionPool`
- **Interactive PTY Shell**: `ShellSession`, `SyncShellSession`
- **Background GNU Screen**: `ScreenPool`, `ScreenSession`, `ScreenResult`, `LogConfig`
- **Hooks (`uniconn.hooks`)**: `audit_log_hook`, `allowlist_hook`, `blocklist_hook`, `MetricsCollector`, `metrics_collector_hook`, `structured_log_hook`
- **Logging (`structlog` + `stdlib`)**: `configure_logging`, `get_struct_logger`, `log_context`, `bind_log_context`, `unbind_log_context`, `clear_log_context`, `get_log_context`, `get_logger`, `setup_file_logging`, `SecretMaskingFilter`
- **Exceptions**: `UniconnError`, `ConnectionError`, `AuthenticationError`, `ExecutionError`, `TimeoutError`, `TransportNotFoundError`, `BMCCapabilityError`, `ScreenError`, `ScreenNotFoundError`, `ScreenSessionExistsError`, `ScreenPoolFullError`

## URI Schemes
- `ssh://[user[:password]@]host[:22][?key_file=...&known_hosts=strict&keepalive=30&ssh_config=true&use_agent=true&proxy=jump1,jump2&proxy_command=...]`
- `local://[?timeout=30]`
- `telnet://[user[:password]@]host[:23][?term_type=vt100]`
- `serial:///dev/ttyUSB0[?baudrate=115200&parity=N&stopbits=1]`
- `ipmi://admin:password@bmc-host[:623]`

## Core API Signatures

### `Connection` (Async) & `SyncConnection` (`conn.to_sync()`)
```python
# Factories
conn = Connection.from_uri(uri: str, retry_attempts: int = 3, logger=None, dry_run: bool = False)
conn = Connection.from_config(config: ConnectionConfig, ...)
conn = Connection.from_dict(data: dict, ...)
conns = Connection.from_file(path: str | Path, *, host: str | None = None, group: str | None = None)
conn = Connection.from_inventory(path: str | Path, host: str)

# Cloning
conn2 = conn.copy(host=..., port=..., username=..., password=..., timeout=..., dry_run=...)
conn2 = conn.with_overrides(**overrides)

# Execution
res: Result = await conn.run(
    command: str | Sequence[str],
    timeout: float | None = None,
    raise_on_error: bool = False,
    input: str | bytes | None = None,
    sudo: bool = False,
    sudo_user: str | None = None,
    sudo_password: str | SecretStr | None = None,
    sensitive: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool | None = None,
    **kwargs,  # cwd, env
)
raw: bytes = await conn.run_bytes(command, timeout=None, raise_on_error=False, input=None, sudo=False, **kwargs)
results: list[Result] = await conn.run_commands(commands: Sequence[str | Sequence[str]], stop_on_error: bool = True, **kwargs)
async for line in conn.stream(command, timeout=None, **kwargs): ...
alive: bool = await conn.is_alive(timeout=None)

# Context Managers (work with both `async with` and `with` for cd/env)
async with conn.cd("/var/www"), conn.env(APP_ENV="prod"):
    await conn.run(["./deploy.sh"])

async with conn.temp_dir(prefix="uniconn_") as tmp_path:
    await conn.write_file(f"{tmp_path}/data.txt", "hello")

# Lifecycle Hooks
conn.add_hook("before_run", callback)  # callback(command_str, host, kwargs)
conn.add_hook("after_run", callback)   # callback(result: Result)
conn.add_hook("on_error", callback)    # callback(exc, command_str, host)

# File Operations (In-memory & SFTP/Local)
content: str | bytes = await conn.read_file(remote_path, encoding="utf-8")  # encoding=None -> bytes
await conn.write_file(remote_path, content: str | bytes, mode: int | None = None, encoding="utf-8")
exists: bool = await conn.exists(remote_path)
await conn.mkdir(remote_path, parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=None)
await conn.upload(local_path, remote_path, recurse=False)
await conn.download(remote_path, local_path, recurse=False)
await conn.chmod(remote_path, 0o755)
info: dict = await conn.stat(remote_path)
names: list[str] = await conn.listdir(remote_path=".")

# Stateful PTY Shell (SSH, Local, Telnet)
async with await conn.open_shell(term_type="xterm", term_size=(80, 24)) as shell:
    await shell.execute("cd /var/log")
    r = await shell.execute("pwd")  # r.text == "/var/log"
    await shell.resize(120, 40)
```

### `Result`
- Properties: `exit_code: int`, `stdout: str`, `stderr: str`, `duration: float`, `command: str`, `host: str | None`, `ok: bool`, `text: str` (`stdout.strip()`), `lines: list[str]`, `sensitive: bool`
- Truthiness: `bool(result)` is `result.ok` (`exit_code == 0`)
- Methods: `result.json() -> Any`, `result.raise_for_status() -> Self`, `result.to_dict() -> dict`

### `ConnectionPool` (Multi-host parallel execution)
```python
pool = ConnectionPool(uris_or_conns, max_concurrent=10, retry_attempts=3)
pool = ConnectionPool.from_file("inventory.yaml", group="web", max_concurrent=10)

async with pool:  # Keeps connections open across multiple pool operations
    results: list[Result] = await pool.map("uptime", sudo=True)
    safe_map: dict[str, Result | Exception] = await pool.map_safe("uptime")
    await pool.upload("./app.conf", "/etc/app/app.conf")
    paths: dict[str, str] = await pool.download("/var/log/syslog", "./logs/{host}.log")
    custom = await pool.apply(lambda c: c.run("hostname"))
```

### `SSHSessionPool` (Single-host SSH channel multiplexing)
```python
async with SSHSessionPool("ssh://user@host", max_sessions_per_conn=6, max_connections=6, health_check=True) as pool:
    res = await pool.run("uptime")
    results = await pool.map(["lshw", "dmidecode", "nvme list"])
    healthy_count = await pool.check_health()
```

### Built-in Hooks (`uniconn.hooks`)
```python
from uniconn.hooks import audit_log_hook, allowlist_hook, blocklist_hook, metrics_collector_hook

conn.add_hook("before_run", allowlist_hook(["ls", "cat", "uptime", "systemctl status"]))
conn.add_hook("before_run", blocklist_hook(["rm -rf /", "mkfs", "shutdown"]))
conn.add_hook("after_run", audit_log_hook("/var/log/uniconn_audit.jsonl", include_output=True, mask_secrets=True))

metrics = metrics_collector_hook()
metrics.attach(conn)  # registers after_run and on_error
```
